Water entering your fireplace or leaving damp stains after rainfall?

Visible cracks or deterioration at the top of your masonry chimney?
Metal flashing separating from the chimney where it meets the roof?
Pieces of mortar, brick, or clay liner falling into your fireplace?
Smoke entering your room or a noticeable change in how your fireplace drafts?
